root.label: FDA produce traceability rule delayed in 2026

events.label: FDA produce traceability rule delayed in 2026

slots.name: implementation status
slots.sentence: The rule was supposed to take effect in January, following years of discussions and revisions with produce companies. But the FDA again delayed its implementation after pushback from industry.

slots.name: enactment year
slots.sentence: The 2011 food safety law called on manufacturers to place bar codes on each batch of produce, so that it can be quickly traced in the event of contamination.
